page.overview:
What is Wind Staff?

"Fujin's Wind Staff concept by Mike Taran. Fujin, the mysterious god of Wind is outfitted with an ancient tree branch. Magical wind energy circles the twigs on the end. There is also metal band with Forest Crystals of unknown origin - maybe the source of the staff's wind energy."
